manage_data_description: Cela ukususwa kwe-akhawunti noma kwedatha yalolu hlelo lokusebenza.
deletion_request_description_1: Faka ikheli le-imeyili elihlotshaniswa ne-akhawunti yakho ukuze ucele ukususwa kwedatha. Sizothumela ikhodi yokuqinisekisa yesikhathi esisodwa ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi ungubani.
deletion_request_description_2: Uma sekuqinisekisiwe, isicelo sakho sizocutshungulwa zingakapheli izinsuku ezingu-30 ngokuvumelana nezibopho zethu zokugcina idatha. Ukususa unomphela futhi akunakuhlehliswa. Olunye ulwazi lungase lugcinwe lapho kudingwa umthetho noma ngezinjongo zokuthobela umthetho.
delete_data_description: Ukungena kwakho kuhlala kusebenza, kodwa okuqukethwe kwakho komuntu siqu kuzosuswa unomphela.
delete_account_label: Susa i-akhawunti yami nayo yonke idatha ehlobene
delete_account_description: Lokhu kuzosusa unomphela ukungena kwakho nokuqukethwe okulondoloziwe.
deletion_warning: Isexwayiso: Ukususa unomphela futhi akunakuhlehliswa. Enye idatha ingase igcinwe ngezizathu zomthetho noma zokuthobela umthetho.
enter_email_description: Faka ikheli lakho le-imeyili ukuze uthole ikhodi yokuqinisekisa.
check_email_description: Sithumele ikhodi yokuqinisekisa enezinhlamvu ezingu-6 ku-{email}. Yifake ngezansi ukuze uqedele inqubo.
